title: Dancing on Her Knees

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Choose a bodily gesture as the main sign because it can convey performance without showing a whole person.
strategic_value: The isolated leg and tilted title can give the production a distinct movement-led image.
demonstration: A yellow stockinged leg and black shoe cut diagonally across a red field above a black panel with magenta title lettering.
practical_value: Compare image direction and title angle when suggesting action in a still poster.

content_islands.name: Leg image
content_islands.spec: Crop the leg from upper left toward the center of the red field.

content_islands.name: Title panel
content_islands.spec: Set the magenta title diagonally across the lower black panel, with the signature on the right edge.
